properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.enabled
properties.description: Whether the opt-in blockify chunking strategy can be selected.

properties.name: studio.chunking.knowledge-block.enabled
properties.description: Whether the opt-in knowledge-block strategy can be selected. It reuses the Blockify/IdeaBlock generation pipeline and stores knowledgeBlock metadata aliases.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.max-input-tokens
properties.description: Maximum estimated input tokens per section for blockify generation.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.max-output-tokens-per-block
properties.description: Maximum output token budget per generated blockify block.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.max-blocks-per-section
properties.description: Maximum generated blockify blocks per source section.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.max-sections-per-document
properties.description: Maximum source sections to process with blockify for one document.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.max-estimated-cost-per-job
properties.description: Estimated cost ceiling available to blockify generator implementations.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.per-job-concurrency
properties.description: Per-job concurrency ceiling available to blockify generator implementations.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.global-concurrency
properties.description: Global concurrency ceiling available to blockify generator implementations.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.generator-type
properties.description: Blockify block generator implementation type. Supported values are heuristic and llm.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.prompt-version
properties.description: Prompt version recorded in blockify metadata and fingerprints.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.generator-model
properties.description: Generator model recorded in blockify metadata and fingerprints.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.llm-provider
properties.description: Default provider used by Blockify LLM generator implementations when the request does not override it.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.llm-model
properties.description: Default model used by Blockify LLM generator implementations when the request does not override it.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.generation-timeout
properties.description: Maximum wait time for one Blockify generator call before falling back for that source candidate.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.temperature
properties.description: Generation temperature recorded for reproducible blockify benchmark runs.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.top-p
properties.description: Generation top-p value recorded for reproducible blockify benchmark runs.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.require-source-evidence
properties.description: Whether generated blockify blocks must include source evidence text found in the source section.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.distillation-enabled
properties.description: Whether Blockify should run deterministic IdeaBlock distillation by removing duplicate normalized question/answer candidates before staging chunks.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.distillation-similarity-threshold
properties.description: Lexical similarity threshold used to mark safe IdeaBlock merge candidates. Candidates are annotated only; they are not merged by this pass.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.document-type
properties.description: Document type override for Blockify profile selection. Supported values are auto, policy, manual, narrative, technical, table-heavy, and general.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.min-answer-chars
properties.description: Minimum answer character count required for a generated blockify block before falling back.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.min-chunk-chars
properties.description: Minimum final blockify chunk character count required before falling back.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.max-chunk-chars
properties.description: Maximum final blockify chunk character count allowed before falling back.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.min-evidence-chars
properties.description: Minimum source evidence character count required for evidence validation.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.enabled
properties.description: Whether Blockify LLM generation masks PII before sending source text to an external LLM.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.required
properties.description: Whether PII masking failure should fail the Blockify pipeline instead of allowing fallback.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.analyzer-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Presidio Analyzer service.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.anonymizer-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Presidio Anonymizer service. Reserved for deployment metadata and future API compatibility.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.language
properties.description: Language code passed to Presidio Analyzer.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.min-score
properties.description: Minimum Presidio analyzer confidence score accepted for masking.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.timeout
properties.description: Timeout for Presidio HTTP requests.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.on-failure
properties.description: Failure policy when Presidio masking fails. Supported values are fail and fallback.

properties.name: studio.chunking.blockify.pii-masking.entity-types
properties.description: Optional allow-list of Presidio entity types to mask. Empty means all detected entity types.
